title: I Watched Melancholia for the First Time

commenti.body: The movie has some beautiful shots. That’s an understatement. But despite the decade that’s passed, I can still recall the green’s lushness, the glinting spring, and the stark paleness of Kristen’s body.

I related to the Part 2 story so much. I have a lot of anxiety so the way the woman was acting made me go "that is so me!" But actually it also made me kind of realise how...silly it is. Like throughout I was a bit like "Well...you can't do much about a planet hitting the earth so I'm not too sure if you shuld be worried" and then was like "maybe I should think that" so whenever I do get a big amout  of anxiety I do go "It's a planet hitting the earth...can't do much about it" lol
